The filed Form 2512 should be amended within 60 days after the reformulated sunscreen-free tanning oil (with swapped emollient) is entered into commercial distribution, because changes to the ingredients or brand name of a cosmetic product require an amended Form FDA 2512 within 60 days of commercial distribution. The renaming of the product constitutes a change in brand name and thus triggers the 60-day amendment requirement. The move of the office does not affect the timing or necessity of the amendment, as it is unrelated to ingredient or brand name changes. No other action is required for the office move.

21 CFR 720.6 requires an amended Form FDA 2512 within 60 days after a cosmetic product's ingredients or brand name changes and it enters commercial distribution [1].  
The requirement applies specifically to changes in ingredient composition or brand name, such as swapping an emollient or renaming the product [1].
